items.ro: Soarele a primit un rework complet pe toate vremile .
items.en: The sun has received a complete rework for all weather conditions.

items.ro: Soarele de acum o sa aiba razele lui in forma de stea .
items.en: The sun, as it is now, will have its rays in the shape of a star.

items.ro: Razele Soarelui apare prin frunzele copacilor .
items.en: The Sun's rays appear through the leaves of the trees.

items.ro: Zapada de pe vremea Xmas nu mai este stralucitoare pe asfalt .
items.en: The snow from Christmastime is no longer bright on the asphalt.

items.ro: Strazile / Trotoarele pe vremea Xmas au fost fixate , acum se pot intelege care este Strada sau Trotuar.
items.en: The streets/sidewalks have been fixed up for the Christmas season; now it’s clear which part is the street and which is the sidewalk.

items.ro: Curcubeul nu ar mai trebuii sa apara cat timp ploua .
items.en: The rainbow shouldn't appear while it's raining.
Fixed an issue in RMS Optional where Mini Map showed as “Currently unavailable”.

items.ro: A fost scos butonul de Connect la Discord Rich Presence .
items.en: RMS Christmas is now available to everyone.
